nodes.description: State variable 'ISalt public salt' storing the external Salt interface used to read startDate() and rawURI().
Constructor(address a) that casts the supplied address into an ISalt interface and assigns it to the 'salt' state variable.
Public view tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) that reads salt.startDate() and computes a shifted token id using block.timestamp arithmetic.
Parameter 'a' (address) of the constructor, used to instantiate the ISalt interface.
Parameter 'tokenId' (uint256) of tokenURI, used as index for rawURI and in unchecked addition.
Local variable 'daysPassed' computed as ((block.timestamp - salt.startDate()) % 180 days) / 1 days.
block.timestamp is used directly in the token id calculation, making tokenURI time dependent.
Unchecked Solidity 0.6.8 arithmetic: subtraction block.timestamp - salt.startDate(), division/modulo, and addition tokenId + daysPassed can overflow/underflow.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter 'a' flows into the constructor body where it is wrapped by ISalt.
The constructor writes the ISalt(a) value into the 'salt' state variable.
tokenURI parameter 'tokenId' is supplied to the tokenURI function body.
block.timestamp influences the control flow and returned URI of tokenURI, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is an operand of the unchecked subtraction computing daysPassed, making the result time dependent.
Function tokenURI reads salt.startDate() from the 'salt' state variable.
salt.startDate() is an operand in the unchecked subtraction that produces daysPassed.
tokenId is added to daysPassed without overflow protection, so an attacker-controlled id can wrap in the unchecked addition.
Local variable daysPassed is the value produced by the unsafe arithmetic operation.
tokenURI executes the unchecked arithmetic expression on the else branch.
daysPassed is used inside tokenURI to compute the shifted token id for salt.rawURI.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter 'a' has no standalone security relevance; it only feeds the assignment of the 'salt' state variable inside the constructor and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter 'tokenId' is only meaningful as an input of tokenURI and its downstream arithmetic, so it should be merged into the tokenURI function node.
Local variable daysPassed exists solely as the result of the unsafe arithmetic operation, so it should be merged into that unsafe_operation node.
